notes.title: Closing
notes.content: Today we are announcing that we will no longer be developing Visions of Zosimos.  This comes after much deliberation and consideration regarding the health of key team members and our ability to continue to resource a product that will fulfill our customers' needs. We cannot thank you enough for your support across this journey over the last 15 years.  We have produced a game we are proud of and your feedback as we did so has been invaluable.  We sincerely wish all of you the best!
